== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Clak'dor VII (Japanese)|Clak'dor VII]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/sputman1021/imagegallery/47850 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 161939275.

Crop rectangle <code>(137, 611, 1304, 2240)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>85f647f4fa2f901c9d97f46ccab66ef80518142f90e63c7676360e4ad4f4371c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
